title: The Last Border Revisited
author: Zephyrine Kavanagh
blurb: Wren Sandoval, a fixer for an embassy that doesn't officially exist, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. But when every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must extract a defector who may be the bait before the summit convenes.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
